title: Gankogui (double iron bell)
summary: The gankogui is a double bell of forged iron: a large and a small cone joined by a curved handle. Struck with a stick, it gives a high and a low note and carries the steady timeline of Ewe drum music.
howToPlay: Four places are lit: the Low bell and the High bell, and the edge of each mouth.
Strike the bell a closing ring marks. The edge gives a short, hard tick.
Keep a steady pattern: the bell is the clock that every other player follows.
rules: A stroke on the beat is perfect, a near one is good, and extra strokes cost points.
The round ends when the last stroke has been judged; the score is the share of the best possible.
heritageNote: A bell pattern repeats unchanged through a whole piece, and the drummers set their rhythms against it. The two cones give the pattern its high and low voices.
credits: Tradition: the gankogui of the Ewe; patterns written for this game
